{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline (e.g., -999.0)
sentinel_check = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].value_counts().get(-999.0, 0)

# Check the distribution of severity
severity_dist = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()

missing_values, sentinel_check, severity_dist"}
